scope: Independent review of progressive lead proposals, document revision chains, contracts, source-preserving scenario recovery, and exact device-point/BOM closure; this report details the two discovered and repaired defects.

findings.title: Original scenario request key bypassed changed installed fixture revision
findings.consequence: An upgraded installation could replay an old import receipt while the same data would reject a fresh-key recovery, contradicting the declared installed-version boundary.
reproduction: Change implementation bytes in a separate runtime copy so fixtureDigest changes.
Call the same sandbox with the original key.

fix.behavior: After ledger and request/actor checks, scenario replay verifies the current installed fixtureDigest before returning cached data. New-key recovery uses the same guard.

findings.title: Design validation checked BOM membership without exact device counts
findings.consequence: A partial or duplicated device layout could carry draft-local-validated status despite not locating the complete solution BOM.
reproduction: Seed isolated customer SG-C06 with a 21-device solution.
Record a 1-device plan or a 22-device plan in a continuous revision chain.
Record the next design against that plan.

fix.behavior: Every non-network/non-outlet point requires an exact SKU. Room/SKU device counts must match every BOM quantity exactly. Unassigned network/outlet preparation points remain permitted.
